prompt:
Create a high-end visual design exploration moodboard for AI Harness, an installable AI-assisted app-building desktop tool for nontechnical Danish municipal workers. This is conceptual raster design, NOT code, NOT a marketing landing page. Landscape board, very high detail, elegant art direction. Board includes a large crisp straight-on desktop application concept (roughly 70% board), a smaller first-use/idea-entry concept, a compact typography sample and 4 color swatches plus a small material/abstract reference crop. Coherent curated layout with generous space. Functional example in main app: user asks to build a municipal meeting-room booking app, conversation and attractive live app preview. Preview shows room names and availability, not a dashboard of fake analytics. Visible app copy is concise natural Danish: "AI Harness", "Mødelokaler", "Hvad vil du bygge?", "Beskriv din idé", "Tilføj reference", "Gem version", "Del testversion". No English slogans, no invented long paragraphs, no AI sparkle icons, no robot art, no gradients unless the specific direction requires it. Legible realistic controls, minimal density, usable contrast. Only the board title and a short three-word mood line outside app. Do not imitate the current app screenshot: rethink the information architecture. 
Exact board title: "01 · Lys præcision". Exact mood line: "Lyst · Præcist · Diskret".
Direction: Native desktop-inspired light design. Cool porcelain white, fine neutral gray separators, tiny cobalt accents, SF-like humanist sans. Slim translucent project rail, compact top toolbar, generous central conversation with integrated review actions, large right preview. Rounded corners subtle and restrained, no big dashboard cards. Material crop frosted glass and brushed aluminium. Small onboarding concept is a single immaculate centered idea composer. Quiet premium utility, precision alignment.
